barriers.reason: A Wednesday 1:00 PM educator visit falls during the patient's warehouse shift (7:00-3:30) and would cost half a shift plus a write-up; the patient is only free after 4:00 PM or Saturday morning.

alternatives.text: Ask the diabetes educator for a chair time after 4:00 PM on a weekday or a Saturday morning appointment, matching the patient's stated availability.

barriers.reason: On workdays the patient eats coffee and gas-station food between the warehouse and Uber driving, with little time to pack meals, so a carb-consistent three-meal plan is hard to follow as written.

alternatives.text: Ask the dialysis/renal dietitian to rebuild the meal plan around foods the patient can actually get on workdays (gas-station and convenience options) rather than assuming packed lunches.
